# FordFit Personal Training

> FordFit Personal Training is a Norfolk personal training business run by Toby Forder, a Level 3 qualified personal trainer and Level 2 gym instructor. It offers 1-to-1 personal training at South Norfolk Leisure Centre in Long Stratton and New Revolution Health & Fitness in Wymondham, home and mobile personal training with a fully equipped van, and online coaching through the FordFit App. Rated 5.0 from over 100 Google reviews across its Long Stratton and Wymondham listings.

Contact: 07495 141804 · toby@fordfitpt.com · Serving Long Stratton, Wymondham, Norwich and South Norfolk

Prices: £45 pay-as-you-go session; monthly packages £160 (4 sessions), £280 (8 sessions), £320 (12 sessions); home sessions from £50; online coaching Basic £20 a month (no set-up fee), Elite £120 a month.

## Services

- [In-person coaching](https://fordfitpt.com/in-person-coaching): 1-to-1 and small-group personal training at gyms in Long Stratton and Wymondham.
- [Personal training in Long Stratton](https://fordfitpt.com/personal-training-South-Norfolk-Leisure-Center): sessions and monthly packages at South Norfolk Leisure Centre.
- [Personal training in Wymondham](https://fordfitpt.com/Personal-Training-New-Revolution-Wymondham): sessions and monthly packages at New Revolution Health & Fitness, a 24/7 gym.
- [Home and mobile personal training](https://fordfitpt.com/personal-training-home-and-mobile): Toby brings the equipment to your home, garden or garage; from £50 a session.
- [Online coaching](https://fordfitpt.com/online-coaching): tailored training and nutrition plans, check-ins and progress tracking in the FordFit App.
